The person behind the work

Hi, I’m Karthik.
Designer, by nature.

Curiosity connects
the dots.

I’m a UI/UX and graphic designer with 8+ years of experience across healthcare, web and e-commerce, and automotive design.

My background in applied arts and computer graphics shaped how I think about design: structure and expression belong together. I enjoy turning a complex workflow into something people can understand, while giving it a visual identity that feels considered.

My work spans research, user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, interface systems, brand identity, and print. I collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to connect design choices with the task at hand.
